name: I could use / 너무 영어스러워서 지나칠 뻔한 영어표현

keywords.ko: I wish I could 는 원하고 있었으면 좋겠다고 말하지만, 필요하다의 뉘앙스는 부족함.
는 필요한 것에 대한 내용을 조금 더 강조하는 반면
라고 많이 표현하는데 이 표현은 '원하는' 요소가 더 강조되는 표현입니다.

keywords.en: ex) I could really go for some sushi.
A: I could really use a cup of coffee right now.
keywords.ko: 아… 지금 커피 한잔 했으면 딱 좋겠어.

keywords.en: = I wish I could have(drink) a cup of coffee right now.
B: Are you still working on that report? If you want , I can take a look at it for you.
keywords.ko: 너 아직도 그 보고서 일 하고 있는거야? 원하면 내가 한번 봐줄까?

keywords.en: A: Would you? Yeah. I could really use some advice
keywords.ko: 그래줄래? 그래. 조언이 진짜 필요하긴 해.(상대방에게 부탁하는 샹황에서)

keywords.en: B: Of course, You know, you look like you could use a break right now. Why don’t you go and lie down for a while.
keywords.ko: 그럼~ 너, 좀 쉬어야 될 것 같은데 저기 가서 좀 누워 있지 그래?(상대방이 필요해보일 때 사용함)
bold_words: you could use a break right now

keywords.en: A: I could really use a cup of coffee right now.
B: Are you still working on that report? If you want, I can take a look at it for you.
A: Would you? Yeah. I could really use some advice.
B: Of course. You know, you look like you could use a break.
Why don’t you go and lie down for a while.

my_sentences.en: I could really use ~
my_sentences.ko: (내가 ~가 필요해/간절해)

my_sentences.en: I could really use a nap right now.
my_sentences.ko: 지금 낮잠 한숨 자면 소원이 없겠어.

my_sentences.en: I'm totally swamped. I could use a hand with this.
my_sentences.ko: 일이 너무 밀렸네. 이것 좀 도와주면 정말 좋겠어.

my_sentences.en: I could use some fresh air after staring at this screen all day.
my_sentences.ko: 하루 종일 모니터만 봤더니 바깥 공기 좀 쐬어야겠어.

my_sentences.en: To be honest, I could use some good news today.
my_sentences.ko: 솔직히 오늘은 기분 좋은 소식이 좀 들려왔으면 좋겠어.

my_sentences.en: I could really use a drink after the week I've had.
my_sentences.ko: 이번 주 내내 시달렸더니 시원하게 한잔 딱 마셨으면 좋겠다.

my_sentences.en: You look like you could use ~
my_sentences.ko: (너 ~가 필요해 보여)
bold_words: You look like you could use ~

my_sentences.en: You look like you could use some rest.
my_sentences.ko: 너 좀 쉬어야 할 것 같은데.

my_sentences.en: You've been pacing around for an hour. You look like you could use a glass of water.
my_sentences.ko: 너 한 시간째 서성이고 있어. 물 한 잔 마시는 게 좋겠어.

my_sentences.en: Rough day? You look like you could use a hug.
my_sentences.ko: 오늘 힘든 일 있었어? 안아줘야 할 것 같은데.

my_sentences.en: That box looks heavy. You look like you could use a hand.
my_sentences.ko: 그 상자 무거워 보이네. 도움이 필요해 보여.

my_sentences.en: You look like you could use a good laugh right now.
my_sentences.ko: 너 지금 기분 전환 삼아 크게 한번 웃어야 할 것 같아.
[퇴근 직전 업무 과부하 상황]

my_sentences.en: A: How's the presentation coming along?
my_sentences.ko: (발표 준비는 잘 돼가?)

my_sentences.en: B: Honestly, I could really use a second opinion on these slides.
my_sentences.ko: (솔직히 이 슬라이드들 피드백 좀 받아봤으면 좋겠어.)
bold_words: I could really use a second opinion

my_sentences.en: A: Send them over. Let me review them for you.
my_sentences.ko: (보내줘. 내가 한번 봐줄게.)
[지쳐 쓰러지기 직전인 친구를 볼 때]

my_sentences.en: A: I still have three more chapters to read tonight.
my_sentences.ko: 나 오늘 밤에 아직 3단원이나 더 읽어야 해.

my_sentences.en: B: Stop. You look like you could use some sleep. Your eyes are bloodshot.
my_sentences.ko: 그만해. 너 잠 좀 자야 될 것 같아. 눈이 완전 충혈됐어.
bold_words: You look like you could use some sleep.

my_sentences.ko: [쇼핑이나 인테리어 조언을 구할 때]

my_sentences.en: A: Are you going to buy that sofa?
my_sentences.ko: 그 소파 살 거야?

my_sentences.en: B: I'm not sure. I could use some advice on matching colors.
my_sentences.ko: 잘 모르겠어. 색 조합 관련해서 조언 좀 들었으면 좋겠는데.

my_sentences.en: take a look at ~
my_sentences.ko: (가볍게 한 번 살펴보다/검토하다)check나 review보다 일상적이고 부담 없는 표현입니다.

my_sentences.en: Could you take a look at my resume before I submit it?
my_sentences.ko: (제출하기 전에 내 이력서 한 번 봐줄 수 있어?)

my_sentences.en: Would you?
my_sentences.ko: (정말 그래줄래?)
상대방의 호의 어린 제안(If you want, I can...)을 기쁘게 수락할 때 짧고 강하게 쓰는 리액션입니다.

my_sentences.en: “I can drive you home.” — “Would you? That would be great!”
my_sentences.ko: “내가 집까지 태워다 줄게.” — “정말 그래줄래? 그럼 너무 고맙지!”

my_sentences.en: for a while
my_sentences.ko: (한동안, 잠시 동안)
단순한 for a moment나 for a second(아주 잠깐)와 달리, 휴식이나 충전을 위해 일정 시간 여유를 두는 뉘앙스입니다.

my_sentences.en: Step away from your desk for a while.
my_sentences.ko: 잠시 자리에서 일어나 머리 좀 식혀.
